verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a game engine and editor, so the axis applies. However, no evidence item documents any Unity setting, flag or policy for disabling telemetry or usage tracking. Community comments only describe Unity 'phoning home', which shows tracking exists but says nothing about an opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
